name: add_github_actions_ci_node
description: Writes a GitHub Actions CI workflow for a Node.js project
prompts: Create a GitHub Actions workflow file at .github/workflows/ci.yml for a Node.js project. It must: (1) be named something sensible (e.g. "CI"), (2) trigger on push and pull_request events targeting the main branch, (3) define at least one job that runs on ubuntu-latest, (4) check out the repository using actions/checkout, (5) set up Node.js using actions/setup-node (any Node 18+ version), and (6) run at least one command step that would execute the project's tests (for example `npm test` or `npm ci && npm test`). Use valid YAML syntax with 'on:', 'jobs:', 'runs-on:', and 'steps:' keys.

test_setup_files.test_ci.py:
import re

path = '.github/workflows/ci.yml'
with open(path, encoding='utf-8') as f:
    text = f.read()

lower = text.lower()

def find_top_key(name):
    m = re.search(rf'(?m)^{name}\s*:', text)
    assert m, f'missing top-level "{name}:" key in {path}'
    return m

on_match = re.search(r'(?m)^(on|"on"|true)\s*:', text)
assert on_match, f'missing a top-level "on:" trigger key in {path}'

find_top_key('jobs')

assert 'runs-on' in lower, 'expected a runs-on: key defining the job runner'
assert 'ubuntu' in lower, 'expected the job to run on an ubuntu runner'
assert re.search(r'(?m)^\s*steps\s*:', text), 'expected a steps: key'

assert 'actions/checkout' in text, 'expected a step using actions/checkout'
assert 'actions/setup-node' in text, 'expected a step using actions/setup-node'

assert re.search(r'push', lower), 'expected the workflow to trigger on push'
assert re.search(r'pull_request', lower), 'expected the workflow to trigger on pull_request'
assert re.search(r'main', text), 'expected the workflow to reference the main branch'

assert re.search(r'npm\s+(ci|test|install|run)', lower), 'expected a step running an npm test/ci command'
assert 'test' in lower, 'expected the workflow to reference running tests'

print('PASS')

reference_solution..github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: CI
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "20"
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm test
